Block Sailor - BLOCK Info & Tokenomics

Block Sailor - BLOCK is the Best Optimized, Highest Paid in BNB & Auto-Compounding Protocol, designed to prevent all of the aforementioned factors from becoming the usual trace of circumstances that leads to price declines. Have you ever dreamt of a token that sails through the crypto waves, steering clear of market crashes and uncertainties? Look no further! Block Sailor is not just a token; it's your ticket to a smarter and safer journey in the crypto world. We therefore designed and developed a token that rewards holders in a way that no other cryptocurrency does, based on all of those tokens and coin experiences.let's take a look at why Block Sailor is the world's smartest token.

Reward Every Week

Investors who invest a minimum of $1000 in Block Sailor - BLOCK project will receive weekly interest rate of 2% (in BNB) on their investment both during and after the presale. The interest will be paid out in the form of Binance Smart Chain (BNB) on a weekly basis.Furthermore, investors who invest a minimum of $10,000 in our project will receive a special bonus of 4% weekly (In BNB) on their investment.In addition, on the day of our project's launch, we will hold a live 300 BNB giveaway. Investors who have invested at least 0.5 BNB in BLOCK before the launch day will be eligible to participate in the giveaway. The winner of the giveaway will be selected randomly and announced live during the launch event Please read our Whitepaper for more details.

We want to make sure that joining BLOCK is extremely safe, that's why we use a Dapps pre-sale contract dapp where users can easily connect their wallets and swap BNB to BLOCK.

Reward Every Week

Each unit of gold is represented by a secure token on the blockchain. This not only democratizes gold investment, making it accessible to all, but also ensures transparency through a tamper-proof ledger Powered by Swiss . Block price will be locked lowest with the gold price of market and highest would be set by our community members by waves .

BLOCK Trust Fund:

Say goodbye to crypto crashes! Our Block Treasury Fund is your safety net. No matter the storm in the crypto ocean, Block Sailor ensures a swift recovery.

Smart Trading with BLOCK's High Drop Prevention Algorithm:

No more worries about massive token sales! Our cutting-edge AI rejects any transaction selling less than 0.1% of the total supply. Bye-bye, price fluctuations!

The Black Hole:

Participate in our "Black Hole" burning strategy for long-term benefits. A unique feature that rewards those who set sail with us on this incredible journey.

Automatic Buy and Sell Tax:

Trading made easy! OpenAI manages our Buy and Sell Tax for efficient transactions all buy and sell tax will be reimbursement to all community members
